about: The Homecoming race (docs/SCHOOL-RACE.md). Cliques, the squad, the reigning royals, other people, the clash and choice cards (with hidden odds and later consequences) and the weekly inbox. Read only by the server and the preview (lib/schoolContent.ts).

squad.name: Priya Raman
squad.wants: Honesty. She leaves if you cheat twice.

squad.name: Marco Reyes
squad.vibe: Knows every door code on Greek Row

rivals.name: Chad Wellington III
rivals.entrance: New face? Cute. Homecoming's mine. It's always mine.
taunts: Saw your poster. Bold font choice.
My dad's name is on the library. What's on yours?
rivals.win: Chad has been dethroned. He's taking it well. He is not.
rivals.loss: Chad keeps the crown. His speech thanked his dad twice.

rivals.name: Marisol Vega
rivals.entrance: Oh, you're running? That's adorable. I have a podcast about adorable.
taunts: Saw your poster. Bold font choice.
My podcast has 40,000 listeners. Who listens to you?
rivals.win: Marisol has been dethroned. She's taking it well. She is not.
rivals.loss: Marisol keeps the crown. Her speech thanked her podcast sponsors twice.

people.name: Dean Harwell
people.vibe: Has read every complaint ever filed

cards.title: The rager is Thursday. The midterm is Friday.

options.label: Go all night
options.receipt: You closed it down. The midterm was a blur.

options.label: Show up, leave by 11
options.receipt: Three photos, one perfect exit. Studied until 1.

options.label: Stay in and study
options.receipt: Aced the practice test. {Rival} owned the night.

cards.over: A text from an unknown number
cards.title: Friday's midterm answers. Free. Delete after reading.

options.label: Use them
options.cost: Your name on a file somewhere
options.receipt: You passed with an 88. Nobody else noticed. Yet.

options.label: Report it to the Dean
options.receipt: The Dean thanked you. Marco hasn't spoken to you since.

options.label: Delete it, study instead
options.receipt: Two nights in the library. You passed. Barely.

cards.title: {Rival} pays a grad student to take their exams.

options.label: Tell Lola's Blotter
options.cost: You win with a cloud over it
options.receipt: It's on the Blotter by midnight. {Rival}'s phone hasn't stopped buzzing.

options.label: Keep it. For now.
options.cost: You know, and they'll find out you know
options.receipt: You save the screenshot. Nobody knows. Yet.

options.label: Let it go
options.receipt: You walk past. Some wins aren't worth it.

cards.title: Your party got reported. The Dean wants a name.

options.label: Take the blame
options.receipt: You signed the form. Tobi made you a second sign.

options.label: Let Tobi say it was his
options.cost: Tobi is suspended for a week, and he knows
options.receipt: Tobi took it. He hasn't looked at you since.

options.label: Tell the truth
options.receipt: She's worried. She's also proud. Mostly worried.

cards.title: The Dean found the answer key in a group chat. Your name is on the read list.

options.label: Go to the hearing
options.cost: Off the ballot until it's cleared
options.receipt: "My office. 9 AM. Bring nothing but the truth."

cards.title: The Dean names you in the Honor Code newsletter.

options.label: Take the bow
options.get: +8 Rep · two cliques warm to you

cards.title: {Rival} finds out you know. They offer a deal: the Athletes' votes for your silence.

options.label: Take the deal
options.receipt: A handshake behind the gym. Nobody saw. Probably.

options.label: Refuse
options.receipt: "Your loss," they said. It sounded like a threat.

cards.title: Your mom is coming to Homecoming. She wants to meet your professors.

options.label: Tell her before she lands
options.receipt: She cried. Then she bought you a tutor.

options.label: Hope she forgets
options.receipt: She did not forget. She found your professor. In the stands.

inbox.subject: Greek Row could be yours
inbox.body: Our house votes as a block. For C$500 and one favor later, they're yours. Thursday, my place.

inbox.subject: Paper due Friday
inbox.body: My scholarship rides on this paper. Can you co-write Thursday night? I know the mixer is Thursday.

inbox.subject: lol
inbox.body: Saw your poster. Bold font choice. See you at Homecoming, Nobody.

inbox.subject: Your angles
inbox.body: I can make you look like you've always been famous. C$150 a week, and you post what I say.
